author: dfoley323
body:
* Do 1-2 horde dungeons (non boss) to collect memories of kings
* use event hub to craft lake water
* use lake water to spawn 4 monuments at a time
* do 1 of each path , make sure to kill all event mobs in each monument
* You now have enough for 1-4 super raids.
* repeat the craft lake water -> monument steps until rank 250+
